Chapter 1 — Parse

Load the schema plugin, open an IFC file, and read wall attributes.

Starting…

1. Open the file

const runtime = await ifcopenshell.init();
await runtime.loadPlugin('schema', 'ifc4');
const model = ifcopenshell.open(bytes, 'sample.ifc');
Waiting…

2. Get elements

const walls = model.byType('IfcWall');
Waiting…

3. Read attributes

const wall = walls[0];
const summary = {
  id: wall.id(),
  type: wall.isA(),
  name: wall.Name,
  guid: wall.GlobalId,
};
Waiting…

4. Log the result

console.log(wall.id(), wall.isA(), wall.Name, wall.GlobalId);
model.dispose();
